# Chefaleh

> Chefaleh is an ORB certified kosher private chef and Shabbat catering service delivering fresh Friday meals across South Florida.

Chefaleh prepares small-batch kosher Shabbat meals, event catering and private chef style menus with Israeli and Mediterranean influences. Orders placed by Thursday at 2:00 PM Miami time are scheduled for Friday delivery between 3:00 and 5:00 PM.

## Ordering

Chefaleh accepts pre-orders for Friday Shabbat delivery. Orders placed after Thursday at 2:00 PM Miami time are scheduled for the following Friday.
